recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-33394 unless a future work-group decision separately chooses Specimen-side procedure modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-33394 was a Published R5 Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for Procedure to include information about the Specimen on which a Procedure was performed. The final resolution was to add Specimen to Procedure.focus rather than add a new Procedure.specimen element.
initial_application: Commit 12c0383ef875059f3622e2c076afe35997217b74 explicitly applied J#33394 by adding J#33394 to Procedure.focus committee notes and adding http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Specimen as a Procedure.focus Reference targetProfile. That commit also contained unrelated Procedure performer changes for another Jira, so reconciliation reviewed only the Procedure.focus application.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists procedure=Procedure as an active resource. Jira comments and Confluence references show PC and OO considered alternatives including a new Procedure.specimen element or Specimen-side modeling, but the final voted R5 disposition was the narrower Procedure.focus target-profile change. Direct Zulip key search found no hits, and broader Procedure/Specimen/focus Zulip search found no relevant conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml already carries J#33394 on Procedure.focus and includes Specimen in the target profile list, satisfying the final Jira resolution in active build-scope source.
